description:
• About our brand and products:

Mana stands for holistic health, awareness, and life energy.
With Mana Kendra (Bern) as a center for therapy, coaching, and education, and the Mana Shop as our online platform, we combine deep expertise with carefully selected products.

Our product range includes:

  • Natural products & supplements
  • Incense, essential oils & ritual tools
  • Yoga & meditation accessories
  • Products that support body, mind, and energy

All products are thoughtfully curated to help people bring more balance, vitality, and self-connection into their daily lives—without exaggerated or unrealistic health claims.

• What makes us different:

  • Holistic approach (body, mind, emotions & energy)
  • Unique combination of physical center (Mana Kendra) and online shop (Mana Shop)
  • Strong professional background in therapy, massage, coaching, and TCM/mycotherapy
  • Real hands-on experience, not just e-commerce
  • Carefully selected, high-quality products
  • Focus on sustainability, authenticity, and real-life impact

We don’t just sell products—we support transformation.

• How affiliates can earn:

  • Commission on every successful order through your referral link
  • Potential recurring income from repeat customers (depending on setup)
  • Attractive margins due to high-quality products
  • Opportunity for long-term collaboration

👉 Many of our products (e.g. supplements, incense) are purchased regularly, increasing your earning potential.

• How to promote us:

You can promote Mana authentically across different channels:

  • Social media (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook)
  • Blog articles & personal reviews
  • Email marketing & newsletters
  • Coaching, yoga, or therapy environments
  • Communities focused on health, spirituality & personal growth

Best results come from:
👉 honest, personal recommendations rather than traditional advertising
